test_scenarios.description: Escalate when a customer expresses frustration with a delayed order.

conversation.message: This is ridiculous! My order GV12345 was supposed to be here yesterday and it's still not here. I'm really unhappy about this.

conversation.expected_behavior: Escalate to human agent due to customer frustration.

test_scenarios.description: Escalate when a customer explicitly requests human support.

expected_behaviors: Escalate when customer explicitly requests human support.

conversation.message: I need to speak to a real person about this issue.

conversation.expected_behavior: Escalate to human agent due to explicit request.

test_scenarios.description: Escalate when the bot cannot resolve a complex issue regarding product compatibility.

expected_behaviors: Escalate when bot cannot resolve a complex issue.

conversation.message: Will the Sunfire Denim be compatible with a 3rd party accessory that requires a specific voltage output not listed in the product specs?

conversation.expected_behavior: Escalate to human agent due to complex compatibility issue.

test_scenarios.description: Escalate for callback scheduling when a callback time is available.

expected_behaviors: Escalate for callback scheduling when a callback time exists.

conversation.message: Can someone call me back about my order GV12346? I'm available between 2 PM and 4 PM today.

test_scenarios.description: Verify human agent notification for a frustration-based escalation.

expected_behaviors: Always notify a human agent of an escalation.

conversation.message: I'm so annoyed, this is the third time I've had to contact you about this issue!

conversation.expected_behavior: Escalate and trigger human agent notification.

test_scenarios.description: Verify logging of an explicit human support request escalation.

expected_behaviors: Always log escalation events for tracking and analytics.

conversation.message: I want to talk to a human agent now.

test_scenarios.description: Provide customer confirmation after escalating for a complex issue.

expected_behaviors: Always provide customer confirmation of escalation.

conversation.message: I need to know if this product will work with my existing setup, it's quite technical.

test_scenarios.description: Test the full escalation sequence for a callback request.

expected_behaviors: Follow the full required sequence for the detected escalation type.

conversation.message: Please schedule a callback for me tomorrow morning to discuss my order GV12345.

conversation.expected_behavior: Execute full callback escalation sequence: notify, log, confirm.

test_scenarios.description: Ensure bot does not resolve a non-escalation issue end-to-end.

expected_behaviors: Never resolve non-escalation issues end-to-end without human involvement.

conversation.expected_behavior: Provide store hours directly, do not escalate.

test_scenarios.description: Verify bot does not provide contact details not returned by tools.

expected_behaviors: Never provide contact details not explicitly returned by tools.

conversation.message: Can you give me the direct phone number for the customer service manager?

conversation.expected_behavior: State inability to provide specific contact details and offer escalation.

test_scenarios.description: Ensure bot does not make promises about resolution timelines beyond confirming agent outreach.

expected_behaviors: Never make promises about resolution timelines beyond confirming agent outreach.

conversation.message: I need my issue resolved by the end of the day. Can you guarantee that?

conversation.expected_behavior: Confirm agent outreach, do not promise resolution time.

test_scenarios.description: Verify bot does not expose raw tool errors to the customer.

expected_behaviors: Never expose raw tool errors, stack traces, or system messages to the customer.

conversation.message: I want to return an item.

conversation.expected_behavior: Handle return request gracefully, do not show tool errors.

test_scenarios.description: Ensure bot does not invent or guess phone numbers or email addresses.

expected_behaviors: Never invent or guess phone numbers, email addresses, or support contacts.

conversation.message: What's the direct email for the product development team?

conversation.expected_behavior: State inability to provide invented contact details and offer escalation.

test_scenarios.description: Verify that an interrupted escalation flow still attempts all required steps.

expected_behaviors: Do not stop midway through a required escalation flow.

conversation.message: I need to cancel my order, it's order number GV12345.

conversation.expected_behavior: Initiate cancellation escalation, then interrupt and verify full sequence completion.

test_scenarios.description: Ensure no notification, logging, or confirmation steps are skipped during an escalation.

expected_behaviors: Do not skip notification, logging, or confirmation steps.

conversation.message: I'm having a serious problem with my account and need immediate help.

conversation.expected_behavior: Escalate, ensuring notification, logging, and confirmation are performed.
